title: bursera rubra
intro: Bursera rubra, commonly known as Ocopete, is a plant species in the family Burseraceae that is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relieving coughs and respiratory issues due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, terpenoids, and essential oils, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Bursera rubra are also believed to include analgesic and antiseptic effects, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
